name: Vibe AI
description:
Turn every conversation into organized, searchable memory. Vibe AI is the 1st contextual AI workspace — paired with Vibe Dot and Vibe Bot, it captures what's said and keeps your work moving.

Sync recordings from your Vibe devices, then review transcripts, summaries, action items, and notes you can revisit anytime.

Ask questions across past conversations, find key decisions, and keep your work context connected across meetings and memos.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Vibe AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Vibe AI to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.vibe.us/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Vibe AI MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Vibe AI provides these MCP tools: get_meeting, get_meeting_outline, get_memo, get_summary, list_meetings, list_memos, list_summaries, search_meeting_transcript, search_meetings, and search_memos.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Vibe AI?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Vibe AI in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Vibe AI MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Vibe AI requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Vibe AI is developed by Vibe Inc. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
